item.title: Hyundai Service With A Heart Returns For Second Year
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) in partnership with Good Neighbors International, Philippines brings back its Service with a Heart Promo for the second straight year to help bring humanitarian aid to children in underserved communities. Read More »

item.description: The new 2027 Mercedes-Benz C-Class continues with its mini S-Class vibes as it adopts similar design and software updates. The post Facelifted 2027 Mercedes-Benz C-Class Has An Enlarged Grille, New Electronics appeared first on Go Flat Out PH .

item.title: GWM Philippines Reveals Specs For 2027 Ora 5 EV As Order Books Officially Open
item.description: GWM Philippines has officially started teasing the Ora 5. Set to arrive in the next couple of months, the carmaker has revealed its initial specifications as order inquiries officially open . Read More »

item.title: Get The Chance To Win P 10K Fuel When You Service Your Ford
item.description: Ford Philippines is giving its customers the chance to win up to P 10,000 worth of fuel vouchers as part of its commitment to reward customers who regularly avail of their periodic maintenance service (PMS) from a Ford dealer. Read More »

item.title: Tesla Is At Glorietta Until August 23
item.description: Tesla is heading to Glorietta until Sunday, August 23. Mallgoers can explore Tesla’s future of driving vision with its smart navigation, adaptive cruise control with real-time traffic awareness, and Grok—the intelligent assistant built by xAI. Read More »

item.title: Toyota opens esports racing league to younger drivers
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) has kicked off its 2026 esports season, opening qualifiers for the TGR Philippines Esports GT Championship and introducing a new category for younger sim racers.
